plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked galvanometer trace shows Faraday's 29 August & 17 October 1831 discovery: a sharp positive current spike (+I) at battery connect / magnet thrust into a 220-foot coil, flat zero (0) while stationary, and a negative spike (-I) when pulled out.

teach_overlay.label: +I ON THRUST · 0 WHILE STILL · -I ON PULL (220-FT COIL)
teach_overlay.detail: Inked galvanometer trace showing Faraday's 29 August 1831 & 17 October 1831 induction experiment (spike +I at battery connect / magnet thrust into 220-foot coil → 0 while steady → spike -I at disconnect / magnet pull out)
teach_overlay.scale: zero volts from a stationary magnet, even if it weighs a ton — but move the magnet with your hand and the electrons jump immediately
